## Local Matters: Haynesville


As a leading local natural gas operator, we work to expand opportunities in the communities where we operate.


November 2026


## Operational Update


It’s been an exciting few months at Expand Energy:


- We acquired Twin Eagle, a natural gas marketing and logistics company. The acquisition expands our ability to deliver natural gas directly to customers across the U.S. and Canada.[Read more](https://www.expandenergy.com/2026/09/16/expand-energy-and-twin-eagle-transaction-closes-combined-organization-creates-north-americas-leading-integrated-natural-gas-company/) .


- We welcomed Danny Brown as our new President and CEO. Danny was previously President and CEO of Chord Energy and before that, he spent nearly 20 years at Anadarko Petroleum leading international, deepwater and U.S. onshore operations. He combines deep industry experience with a talent for building high-performing workplaces. Danny will be visiting each of our operating areas in the coming weeks to meet our employees and see our operations in person.[Read more](https://investors.expandenergy.com/news-releases/news-release-details/expand-energy-corporation-names-danny-brown-president-and-chief) .


- On Oct. 28, we reported our third quarter 2026 results.[Read more](https://investors.expandenergy.com/) .


“With our diversified scale, investment-grade balance sheet and coast-to-coast customer access, Expand Energy is uniquely positioned to monetize the volatility we see in the gas market today, provide advantaged supply to premium markets and capitalize on the demand growth we expect in the future,” said President and Chief Executive Officer Danny Brown. “Capturing value requires a talented team, disciplined capital allocation and operational excellence. I look forward to working with this team to continue the momentum built and firmly establish Expand Energy as North America’s leading integrated gas company.”

### Employee Spotlight


### Get to know Meghan Macdonald, Director of Communications


Meghan joined Expand Energy in September as Director of Communications, bringing international energy experience and a focus on helping people understand and connect with our company’s story.


**How did you end up in the energy industry and what’s kept you interested?**
A former boss and mentor once explained it to me this way: you can’t do anything without energy. It’s fundamental to everything that happens in the world. People get excited about AI, technology and other industries, but none of those can exist without energy.


What’s kept me here is seeing the human impact. I’ve been fortunate to spend time in places where access to affordable, reliable energy looks very different from what we’re used to in the United States. Seeing how that access can transform people’s lives gives you a real appreciation for this industry. I love being part of something so fundamental to human progress.


**What drew you to Expand Energy, and what approach are you bringing to the communications function?**
Expand Energy is incredibly well positioned for the future. Its strategy and the way it’s diversifying to capitalize on growing demand for natural gas really appealed to me. After several years working overseas, I was also really excited to work for an American producer.


Most importantly, the people really stood out to me during the interview process. Everyone I met was nice, talented and collaborative. That’s the kind of environment I want to work in. Two months in, the experience has exceeded my expectations.


As far as my role goes, I want to make sure communications adds strategic value to the business and helps our company capture the opportunities ahead. I feel well positioned to do that at Expand Energy because communications has a seat at the table, insight into what’s happening and colleagues who are eager to engage.


I also love the company’s commitment to continuous improvement, which our new CEO Danny \[Brown\] really embodies. No matter how well things are working today, there’s always an opportunity to make them better, and that’s the mindset I bring to communications.


**What do you like to do outside of work?**
Spoil my pets! I work hard so they can have a better life. My husband and I have one dog — a rescue mutt — and three formerly stray cats who are now all living a life of luxury.

### In the Community


During the past quarter, Expand Energy’s employees have been active members of their communities, supporting charitable initiatives in our operating areas. Highlights include:


- **Supporting Teachers and Students during Back to School**
We helped local educators bring their classroom ideas to life by supporting the Independence Bowl’s Extra Yard for Teachers program. It’s a partnership between the Independence Bowl Foundation and the College Football Playoff Foundation that gives teachers gift certificates for classroom projects of their choice. In August, we also donated 700 clear backpacks at Captain Shreve High School’s freshman orientation to support students in complying with school rules.
- **Helping Parish Fairs Get Ready**
Parish fairs are a highlight of the year across Northwest Louisiana, and getting the grounds ready takes many hands. In September, members of our construction team helped prepare the Red River Parish Fair by hanging signs and cleaning up the grounds. Another group of our employees did the same at the Sabine Parish Fair, helping both communities welcome families for fair week.
- **Welcoming Local Fire Departments to Our Rigs**
Our drilling team has hosted the North Sabine Fire Department and Natchitoches City Fire Department on rig tours this quarter. Having first responders on-site gives them working knowledge of our equipment, better preparing them for an emergency that could occur at any industry facility. We continue to work closely with our local first responders to share knowledge, training opportunities and provide resources to support our Haynesville communities.
